dt: Program status 'waiting for new publication'; last solicitation (NSF 24-597) used Sept 8 annually
e: Funds interdisciplinary graduate traineeships in priority areas such as quantum, AI and semiconductors; under NSF 24-597 an institution could take part in only two proposals per competition. Trainee stipends have historically been limited to US citizens and permanent residents.
unv: No new solicitation posted; next deadline, tracks and trainee-citizenship rule unconfirmed for the next cycle.
